Full-Stack Engineer (Python / React) , Remote

We’re working on building production AI systems , not demos ,focused on real-world workflows, data pipelines, and integrating LLM-based systems into usable products.

Stack: - Python (FastAPI) - React / TypeScript - AWS / PostgreSQL

Work includes: - designing backend systems and APIs - building and scaling LLM workflows (agents, pipelines, RAG) - handling real-world issues like latency, reliability, and hallucination control - integrating AI into product experiences end-to-end

Looking for engineers who: - have built production systems (not just prototypes) - are strong on backend design and data flow - have experience with AI/LLM systems in real use cases

Remote, async-friendly, with some overlap with US timezones preferred.

If interested, apply here: https://lnkd.in/dbiCSZhW

Make sure to check your email (including spam/junk), as that’s required to move forward in the process.
